title: SAMEAT Heated Towel Warmers for Bathroom - Large Towel Warmer Bucket, Wood Handle, Auto Shut Off, Fits Up to Two 40"X70" Oversized Towels, White
features: Extra Large Capacity Towel Warmer: The ultra-large bucket accommodates up to two 40" X 70" oversized bath towels, bathrobes, blankets, and PJs. The listing says to heat cotton materials only, to avoid chemical-fiber or non-heat-resistant items, and not to dry towels or other items that are still damp.

Heats up rapidly and 4 Timer Settings: The listing says the warmer heats up quickly to a comfortable temperature. The built-in timer can keep towels warm for 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, or 4 hours before it shuts off automatically. It defaults to 30 minutes on startup, and the timer indicator stays unlit during that 30-minute interval.
Thermos Bucket Design: SAMEAT says the bucket heats towels all the way through. The same note says it is not safe to touch the interior when the hot surface indicator light is on.
After-sale line on the listing: SAMEAT says customer service responds within 24 hours, with a 30-day return and a 12-month warranty. The product is described as ETL safety certified.

Product information for this white wood-handle bucket (ASIN B0C7KQTXV1, model TW-ST1912): the product description lists 100-120VAC, 60Hz, max current 5A, max power 450W, and item dimensions 21.9 x 13.4 x 13.3 inches. The product table lists package dimensions 19.75 x 12.5 x 12.5 inches and an item weight of 9.18 pounds. The description says not to exceed the total rating, or it may damage the unit and create a fire hazard. The package list is the warmer, an instruction manual, and a paper box.
